title: Circus big top (Safety net) and the props and people of the three acts
made_here: Tent, poles, ring, bleachers, platforms, rope ladders, the high wire, the safety net on wheels, ropes, pulleys, handles, pedestals, follow spots and bunting are modelled in the build script. Canvas stripes, ring paint, pedestal stars, bunting colours and the net (with transparent holes) are drawn by tools/textures_sirk.py; the canvas uses the Fabric Pattern 07 normal map for its weave. The unicycle, balance pole, cannon and trapeze (props.py) and their pictures (props_textures.py: the cannon's gold scrollwork, rope, leather) are modelled and drawn here. The catcher and the seated spectators are MakeHuman people (CC0 system assets, see the people scene), posed still and baked by pose.py; the catcher's leotard and chalked hands are painted on there.

other.name: MakeHuman system assets (bodies, skins, eyes, eyebrows, hair, clothes, shoes, proxy meshes)
other.author: the MakeHuman team (Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier)
